user.title: Set up Dynamic Car Charger
user.description: Connect your existing Wallbox, car battery and NextEnergy price entities. Automatic control starts disabled so you can inspect the plan first.

data.power_entity: Wallbox actual charging power sensor (W or kW)
data.power_kw: Expected charging power from the grid (kW)

data_description.charger_entity: Select the Wallbox charging switch: on resumes, off pauses. Do not select a power relay.
data_description.soc_entity: Use live battery percentage telemetry. A manual helper is an estimate and must be refreshed each session.
data_description.price_entity: Use Enever NextEnergy with prices_today/prices_tomorrow, or a compatible prices list. Configure the source integration first.
data_description.power_entity: Used to estimate energy added between battery percentage changes.
data_description.status_entity: Select the sensor that reports 'Locked, car connected'. This triggers the connected-car event.
data_description.lock_entity: Select the Wallbox lock. It is unlocked before charging and locked again when the vehicle reports Driving.
data_description.vehicle_state_entity: Select the Leapmotor state sensor that reports Driving after the cable has been removed.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Replace the example with your B05 variant’s usable capacity.
data_description.power_kw: Use the lower of car AC capability and configured Wallbox power. Allow for load balancing. This integration does not change the current limit.
data_description.price_adjustment: Enever already includes VAT and levies. Only enter a difference between your contract and the feed.
data_description.interval_minutes: Choose 60 for current NextEnergy hourly billing. Use 15 only if your contract and source both use quarter-hours.
data_description.max_price_eur_kwh: Charge below this price while there is enough time; near the deadline the planner may exceed it to finish.

error.entity_missing: Entity not found. Set up the source integration first.
error.soc_unit: Choose a battery sensor with the unit %.
error.power_unit: Choose a charging power sensor with the unit W or kW.
error.charger_in_use: This charger already has a scheduler.
error.own_switch: Select the Wallbox switch, not this integration’s own automatic charging switch.
error.wrong_domain: Select an entity from the correct domain.

init.title: Charger and tariff settings
init.description: Changing settings reloads the integration and requests a pause before restarting control.
